title: Restrict completion refusal basis refresh to unchanged canonical work
outcome: A pending completion refusal may refresh only across the documented same-target same-holder claim epoch when the canonical work head is unchanged.
acceptance: A same-holder later claim epoch on unchanged work still recomputes the current refusal
Retrying a refused completion after revising the target work conflicts under the old caller key

completion.summary: Restricted completion refusal basis refresh to unchanged canonical work and the same run/session-held claim lineage; added regression coverage for revision changes.
